tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo uparipāsāde divāseyyaṃ upagato.

32711.meaning1: eating food at the wrong time during the day; eating after midday

examples.text: te mayaṃ, bhante, bhagavati pemañ'ca gāravañca hiriñ'ca ottappañ'ca sampassamānā evaṃ taṃ divāvikālabhojanaṃ pajahimhā.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate. atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, āyāma, bhikkhave, yena paṭibhānakūṭo ten'upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā'ti.

32714.meaning1: entered retreat for the day; gone to the meditation place for the day

examples.text: atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā suddhāvāsaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca, akālo kho tāva, mārisa, bhagavantaṃ payirupāsituṃ, divāvihāragato bhagavā paṭisallīno ca. asuko ca brahmaloko iddho c'eva phīto ca, brahmā ca tatra pamādavihāraṃ viharati.

32715.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of divāvihāra

taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
idaṃ sattamaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, vessavaṇassa mahārājassa sahabyataṃ upapajjāmi, so tato cuto manussarājā, amanussarājā divi homi.
cut'āhaṃ diviyā kāyā, āyuṃ hitvā amānusaṃ, amūḷho gabbham'essāmi, yattha me ramatī mano.

32721.meaning1: long (in space or time); tall; deep

hoti kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena tassa mahānirayassa puratthimaṃ dvāraṃ apāpurīyati.

32723.commentary: (MNa) dīgho'ti maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako sahā'ti (dī. ni. 3.293) evaṃ āgato aṭṭhavīsatiyā yakkhasenāpatīnaṃ abbhantaro eko devarājā.

examples.text: atha kho dīgho parajano yakkho yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

32725.meaningLit: section on wandering for a long time

32726.meaning1: wandering for a long time; long walking journey

examples.text: kamm'antaṃ kāreti, adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati, pāmokkhesu bhikkhūsu paṭiviruddho hoti, dīghacārikaṃ anavatthacārikaṃ anuyutto viharati, nappaṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ.
dīghā jaṅghā yassa so'yaṃ dīghajaṅgho, kalyāṇabhariyo, pahūtapañño.
kevalañ'h'ettha yasmiṃ kantāre vāḷamigā vā dīghajātikā vā atthi, so vāḷakantāro.
atha kho dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho nāḷandāyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena pāvārik'ambavanaṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

32732.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of dīgha

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho, kusalo nāgavaniko nāgavanaṃ paviseyya. so passeyya nāgavane mahantaṃ hatthipadaṃ, dīghato ca āyataṃ, tiriyañ'ca vitthataṃ.

puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamatt'ānucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ sama-vippakiṇṇa-vālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādaka-mahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.

mahantassa phalakaṃ soṇḍāya upanibandhati, tomarahattho ca puriso uparigīvāya nisinno hoti, samantato ca tomarahatthā purisā parivāretvā ṭhitā honti, hatthidamako ca dīghatomarayaṭṭhiṃ gahetvā purato ṭhito hoti.

yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu na sādhukaṃ attanā'va attānaṃ paccavekkhati tasm'etaṃ, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati, bhikkhū ca na phāsuṃ viharissantī'ti.

te evarūpaṃ maṇḍana-vibhūsanaṭṭhān'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyath'idaṃ… hatthabandhaṃ sikhābandhaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāḷikaṃ asiṃ chattaṃ citr'upāhanaṃ uṇhīsaṃ maṇiṃ vālabījaniṃ odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni

evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate sūkarakhatāyaṃ. atha kho dīghanakho paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

atha kho māro pāpimā kassakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantaṃ naṅgalaṃ khandhe karitvā dīghapācanayaṭṭhiṃ gahetvā haṭahaṭakeso sāṇasāṭinivattho kaddamamakkhitehi pādehi yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, api, samaṇa, balībadde addasā'ti?

ātume itthibhūtāya, dīgharattāya mārisa, yassā me itthibhūtāya, saṃsāre bahubhāsasī'ti.

tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, dīgharattam'idaṃ cittaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenā'ti. cittasaṃkilesā, bhikkhave, sattā saṃkilissanti. cittavodānā sattā visujjhanti.

32759.commentary: (MNa) evaṃ pakappitaṃ p'etaṃ dīgharatt'ānusayitaṃ, diṭṭhigatam'ajānataṃ, taṃ pakappitaṃ nāmagottaṃ nāmagottamattam'etaṃ, vohār'atthaṃ pakappitan'ti, ajānantānaṃ sattānaṃ hadaye dīgharattaṃ diṭṭhigatam'anusayitaṃ.

examples.text: dīgharatt'ānusayitaṃ, diṭṭhigatam'ajānataṃ, ajānantā no pabrunti, jātiyā hoti brāhmaṇo.

32760.meaning1: long-time latent; underlying for a long period

examples.text: yes'āhaṃ, bhante, pañhānaṃ ito bahiddhā aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammam'pi n'ālatthaṃ, te me bhagavatā byākatā. dīgharatt'ānusayino, yañ'ca pana me vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ, tañ'ca bhagavatā abbuḷhan'ti.

32766.meaning2: fleecy black bedspread; long-haired black spread

dāruṇo baḷisaṃ kummaṃ, dīghalomi ca mīḷhakaṃ, asani diddhaṃ siṅgālaṃ, verambhena sagāthakan'ti.

examples.text: dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmī'ti pajānāti dīghaṃ vā passasanto dīghaṃ passasāmī'ti pajānāti
seyyathā'pi dakkho bhamakāro vā bhamakār'antevāsī vā dīghaṃ vā añchanto dīghaṃ añchāmī'ti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā añchanto rassaṃ añchāmī'ti pajānāti
sare lutte paro saro kvaci ṭhān'āsannaṃ dīghaṃ yāti.
sare lutte pubbo ca kvaci dīghaṃ yāti.

32778.meaning1: living long; long-lived; with a long lifespan

examples.text: āyuṃ datvā balaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, sukhañ'ca paṭibhānakaṃ, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.
na, bhikkhave, nevāpiko nivāpaṃ nivapati migajātānaṃ, imaṃ me nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ migajātā paribhuñjantā dīgh'āyukā vaṇṇavanto ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ yāpentū'ti.
sabb'ītiyo vivajjantu, sabbarogo vinassatu, mā te bhavatv'antarāyo, sukhī dīgh'āyuko bhava.

tatra, bhikkhave, yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, so dīgh'āyukataro ca hoti vaṇṇavantataro ca mahesakkhataro ca. ye pana te sattā pacchā upapannā, te app'āyukatarā ca honti dubbaṇṇatarā ca appesakkhatarā ca.

32781.meaning1: fact of having longevity; fact of being long-lived

examples.text: bhavati yadi gihī ciraṃ yapeti, cirataraṃ pabbajati yadi tato hi, yāpayati ca vas'iddhibhāvanāya, iti dīgh'āyukatāya taṃ nimittan'ti.
iti kho, māṇava, app'āyuka-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā app'āyukattaṃ upaneti, dīgh'āyuka-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā dīgh'āyukattaṃ upaneti

32783.meaning1: leading to being long-lived; conducive to a long lifespan
32783.commentary: (MNa) dīgh'āyuka-saṃvattanikā esā māṇava paṭipadā'ti ettha parittakammena'pi nibbattaṃ pavatte etaṃ pāṇ'ātipātā viratikammaṃ āgantvā atthato evaṃ vadati nāma, sac'āhaṃ paṭhamataraṃ jāneyyaṃ, na te idha nibbattituṃ dadeyyaṃ, devaloke'y'eva taṃ nibbattāpeyyaṃ. hotu, tvaṃ yattha katthaci nibbatti, ahaṃ upatthambhakakammaṃ nāma thambhaṃ te karissāmī'ti upatthambhaṃ karoti. kiṃ karoti? parissayaṃ nāseti, bhoge uppādeti. (MNt) dīgh'āyuka-saṃvattanikaṃ hoti vipākassa kammasarikkhabhāvato.

examples.text: dīgh'āyuka-saṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī viharati.
evaṃ su te ukkiṇṇaparikhāsu okkhittapalighāsu nagar'ūpakārikāsu dīgh'āsibaddhehi purisehi rakkhāpenti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
evaṃ su te ukkiṇṇaparikhāsu okkhittapalighāsu nagar'ūpakārikāsu dīghāsi'vudhehi purisehi rakkhāpenti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti?
mā tvaṃ, tāta dīghāvu, evaṃ manas'ākāsi. iṅgha tvaṃ, tāta dīghāvu, yadeva te bhagavā āha, tadeva tvaṃ sādhukaṃ manasi karohī'ti.

32788.meaningLit: discourse on Dīghāvu the lay follower

32790.commentary: (SNa) tañ'ca kho dīghena addhunā na ittaran'ti tañ'ca sīlaṃ dīghena kālena veditabbaṃ, na ittarena. dvī'ha-tī'hañ'hi saṃyatākāro ca saṃvut'indriyākāro ca na sakkā dassetuṃ.

examples.text: āpadāsu kho, mahārāja, thāmo veditabbo. so ca kho dīghena addhunā na ittaraṃ, manasikarotā no amanasikarotā, paññavatā no duppaññena

bhagavā ce kho pana māgadhake paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu na byākareyya, dīnamanā ten'assu māgadhakā paricārakā, yena kho pan'assu dīnamanā māgadhakā paricārakā kathaṃ te bhagavā na byākareyyā'ti?

bhagavā ce kho pana māgadhake paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu na byākareyya, dīnamanā ten'assu māgadhakā paricārakā, yena kho pan'assu dīnamanā māgadhakā paricārakā kathaṃ te bhagavā na byākareyyā'ti?
tato cittaṃ samādhesiṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃ'va'jāniyaṃ, tato dīpaṃ gahetvāna, vihāraṃ pāvisiṃ ahaṃ, seyyaṃ olokayitvāna, mañcakamhi upāvisiṃ.
ayañ'hi dīp'obhāsaṃ vā aggi-obhāsaṃ vā adisvā maṇiāloken'eva bhuñjati ca nisīdati ca nipajjati ca, devo pana dīpa-ālokena nisinno bhavissatī'ti?
tathāgatassa tattha hatthināgena upaṭṭhiyamānassa vasanabhāvo sakalajambudīpe pākaṭo ahosi
asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo avīci maññe phuṭo bhavissati manussehi, seyyathā'pi naḷavanaṃ vā saravanaṃ vā.

32799.meaning1: terra firma; solid ground; support; help; refuge; place of safety; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: uṭṭhānen'appamādena, saṃyamena damena ca, dīpaṃ kayirātha medhāvī, yaṃ ogho n'ābhikīrati.
majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ, oghe jāte mahabbhaye, jarāmaccuparetānaṃ, dīpaṃ pabrūmi kappa te.
